lines.text: Did pirates really make you walk the plank?
A plank, a sword, a shark. Just like the stories!
Not quite. Real pirates had written rules.
Lose a limb in battle, and the crew paid you eight hundred pieces of eight.
Cheat the crew, and you were left on an empty island, with a gun and a bottle of water.
But the plank? Almost never recorded. Unwanted men simply went over the side.
The plank comes from stories, like Treasure Island and Peter Pan.
